Name: Rajesh Sachdeva
Designation: Founding Partner, Flowering Tree Investment Management
Bio: Rajesh Sachdeva is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Rajesh has 20+ years of Asian equities experience culminating in the founding of Flowering Tree Investment Management Pte. Ltd (FTIM), in June 2008. FTIM manages an Asia focused long short portfolio with an emphasis on Return on Invested Capital and quality of management teams. Before FTIM, Rajesh co-founded Sansar Capital in 2005. In addition to FTIM and Sansar Capital, he has worked in senior buy side investing roles covering Asia at Kingdon Capital and Alliance Capital. He has also worked on the sell-side with a focus on Asia with Citigroup, Credit Agricole Indosuez, Natwest and ICICI Securities (JP Morgan India JV). Rajesh has had a passion for investing since a very early age.
Education: PGDBM, Finance and Marketing, XLRI Jamshedpur | BTech, Mechanical Engineering, IIT Delhi
